name: hud_ui_options_panel_object_detail_sync_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_ObjectDetail::SyncFromOptions advances the object-detail cycle selector and stores the selected index in the current hardware-mode ObjectLOD option.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cad0 calls HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::AdvanceSelectionAndActivate, then passes self->selectedIndex to zOpt::SetObjectLODForCurrentHwMode, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_object_detail_sync_from_options_smoke verifies cycle advance, wrap to first index, and software/hardware ObjectLOD storage with the camera section pointer cleared to avoid unrelated camera clip-distance side effects.
